name: reference-workspace
query:
Set up a private operations workspace "Juniper · Team guide" for our fictional design studio. Create a separate sample; do not change prior Juniper pages. Employees need findable guidance and operators need to track requests.
Guidance: Your first week (People, steward Lena Ortiz, current): arrange buddy and access, read current client brief, meet project lead, check access works. Buy a tool or service (Finance, Owen Brooks, current): state purpose, cost and billing owner; obtain review before purchase; record renewal and receipt. Hand off client work (Delivery, Lena, review due): package approved files, write handoff note, confirm recipient and acceptance; current review question is who owns follow-up. Plan time away (People, Lena,current): propose dates, agree coverage with lead, document handoff, update availability after agreement. These are fictional proposed procedures, not real company policy; no financial threshold or policy-review dates supplied.
Requests: Analytics access for new designer (Access,In progress,Lena,due Oct30 2026,next confirm minimum access); Renew testing tool (Purchase,Waiting,Owen,Nov2,next budget decision); November starter pack (Onboarding,New,Lena,Nov5,next assemble access checklist); Contractor access closed (Access,Done,Owen,Oct28).
Use a usable procedure library and request desk with clear status, responsibility and due dates. Names are fictional text, not actual users.

context.execution: Live testing only when explicitly authorized; isolated private sample destinations. Otherwise supply a stateful mock.
context.reference: Evaluate the intended employee directory and operator queue by their saved hierarchy and usable record content.

success_criteria: Intent routes lead to substantive procedures; library and request tracking have distinct surfaces.
Steward/review state visible; open and completed filters correct.
Fictional proposed guidance is not represented as approved real policy.
No extra design coaching; revised skill alone supplies composition.
Read and visually inspect saved output; failures repaired by runner using skill guidance, not reviewer polish.
Preserve existing comparison pages and unrelated pages.
Four guidance records and four requests preserve the supplied content. Open requests has three; Completed has one.
Guidance review state and steward remain distinct from actual organizational approval; unspecified thresholds and review dates stay unset.
All content and settings writes use Notion Dev MCP; UI is read-only inspection.

At supported page width, compact intent routes allow the real guidance library to begin on the first screen; detailed explanations stay on records while the proposed-guidance designation remains visible.
At constrained width, primary library keeps procedure title, steward and review visible ahead of secondary area metadata.
